title: The Reach of Evidence of Earlier Drug Coverage on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Account
content:
The evidence of earlier creditable drug coverage held on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan enrollment intake decides the span of coverage months over which the penalty months are counted.

1. Where the evidence held on the enrollment intake is a certificate of creditable coverage on file, and at least 1 penalty charge stands on the premium account, the months are counted over every coverage month the account has charged a penalty for since coverage began.
2. Where the evidence held on the enrollment intake is coverage verified with the prior carrier, and at least 1 penalty charge stands on the premium account, the months are counted over the coverage months the account has charged a penalty for in the 12 months up to the handling date.
3. Where neither of those holds, the months are counted over the coverage months the account has charged a penalty for in the 3 months up to the handling date.

| Evidence standing on the enrollment intake | Penalty charges on the premium account | The span the months are counted over |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A certificate of creditable coverage on file | 1 or more | every coverage month charged a penalty since coverage began |
| Coverage verified with the prior carrier | 1 or more | the 12 months up to the handling date |
| A certificate of creditable coverage on file | none | the 3 months up to the handling date |
| Coverage verified with the prior carrier | none | the 3 months up to the handling date |
| Any other evidence, or none | any | the 3 months up to the handling date |

Each window is counted back from the handling date and each counts coverage months the account has charged a penalty for, not calendar months in which nothing was charged. The 12-month span and the 3-month span are windows; the first row is not a window at all but the whole of the account since coverage began.

## Worked on a hypothetical account

Take an account that has charged a penalty for 9 coverage months since coverage began, of which 5 fall in the 12 months up to the handling date and 2 in the 3 months up to the handling date. With a certificate of creditable coverage on file the count is 9; with coverage verified with the prior carrier it is 5; with neither on the intake it is 2.
